name: USMLE Step 2 CK Prep: Vignetta
subtitle: Vignettes, ECG, pathways, mock
shortDescription: Original Step 2 CK vignettes, decision pathways, ECG strips and lab drills with a cited guideline behind every answer. Free, works offline.
longDescription:
Vignetta is a free study aid for medical students and graduates preparing for USMLE Step 2 CK. It teaches the way the exam asks: a short patient vignette, five options, and a decision that matters (diagnosis, next best step, management, prevention, ethics, biostatistics).

### What You Get
- 142 original clinical vignettes spread across the published Step 2 CK content outline (clinical sciences, systems and physician tasks).
- Tutor practice with instant explanations, or a timed 30-minute block of 20 items that follows the blueprint weights. Explanations unlock when the block ends.
- Decision pathways you walk step by step: chest pain, pulmonary embolism, sepsis in the first hour, acute stroke, hypertension in pregnancy and upper GI bleeding.
- Eight ECG rhythm strips drawn for this app, ten lab, blood gas, CSF and pleural fluid drills, and a biostatistics lab with live sensitivity, specificity, PPV and NPV.
- Spaced repetition: missed vignettes return the same day, correct ones after 1, 3, 7, 14 and 30 days.
- A starting check that finds your weak systems, a mistake notebook, and a practice readiness estimate.
- Every explanation links to the guideline behind it. Sources open inside the app at 85 percent height, with Back and Close.
- Large-text controls (A- and A+), works offline, no account, no sign-in.

### Honest Limits
Questions are original and were checked against cited guidelines in several automated passes; they have not been reviewed by a licensed physician. Scores in the app are practice estimates from your percent correct and are not USMLE scores. The real exam has sixteen blocks; the app offers a two-block mini mock because its bank is smaller. Step 2 CS no longer exists, so Vignetta covers Step 2 CK only.

### Free, With Optional Plus
Vignetta is free with ads between practice sets (never during a timed block). Vignetta Plus is an optional monthly subscription that removes ads and unlocks unlimited timed blocks, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Cancel any time in your App Store or Google Play account settings. If you cancel, you keep ad-free until the end of the period you already paid for, and you will not be charged again. Prefer not to subscribe? Watch short videos to earn credits and unlock features. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel it in your account settings.

### Important
USMLE is a joint program of the NBME and the FSMB. Vignetta is an independent product and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by the NBME, the FSMB or the USMLE program. Vignetta is for adults 18 and over. It is an educational tool and not medical advice; never use it to diagnose or treat a real patient.
